reasoning_content: Now Node.js. Let me install Node 22 via NodeSource or nvm. NodeSource setup script. Let's use nvm? Simpler: download Node binary tarball. Let me check needed Node version from frontend package.json.

action.command: cd /workspace && cat frontend/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "==="; cat frontend/app/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== engines/packageManager ==="; grep -rn "packageManager\|\"node\"" frontend/package.json frontend/app/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "=== .nvmrc ==="; find . -maxdepth 3 -name ".nvmrc" -o -maxdepth 3 -name ".node-version" 2>/dev/null | head
